tests.description: Baseline complaint created for workflow testing
Student CANNOT endorse their own complaint
Peer student can endorse complaint (+1 vote registered)
Duplicate endorsement attempt is idempotent (no duplicate count)
Admin successfully reassigns department and technician
Unauthorized student cannot transition status to resolved
Admin transitions complaint to resolved with resolution summary
Complainant author successfully marks complaint as verified
Admin adds confidential internal note to ticket
SLA escalation engine automatically detects and marks overdue complaints
